title: Melodi mo Dimmbini Koye
intro: Aɗa jogori udditde daartol maccuɗo Alla teskinɗo. E nder leydi nulaaɓe e laamɓe, ooɗoo limre barkiniraa ko deftere diine, daande doole, e doole dow njamndi. No njanngir-ɗaa nate ɗee nii, mbele aɗa waawi anndude hol mo ɗum waawi wonde ?
clues: Miin ko mi maccuɗo Alla dokkaaɗo deftere heeriinde.
Miɗo jogii daande belnde, yettoode am ina yiɗaa haa hay koɗli e colli ina njokkondiri e am.
Mi hawri e gaño mawɗo e nder hare lollunde, hay so mi ɓurii famɗude, mi dañii.
Njamndi waɗaama e am pliant, ina addana mi waɗde kaɓirɗe e juuɗe am.
Mi laatiima laamiiɗo dow lenyol mawngol, anndal am nder kiita anndinaama.
Ɓiɗɗo am, annabi kadi, rokkaama doole e dow henndu e jinneeji.
arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
